name: website-first-pending-copy
goal: Visitors see Mac app coming soon while the Hub archive is unavailable

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: With no published ZIP, both the hero link and the disabled download action currently read Download for Mac. The approved website-first state requires Mac app coming soon, while a published ZIP keeps Download for Mac.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing HomeDownload render and hosted-home patterns asserted old pending copy and never distinguished its label from the live archive. Existing pending, available, and layout cases now assert the amended state.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At f09d149c90 both pending actions fail the exact label assertion. Harness record f3e36a6acaa3. The frozen Workerd browser spec also fails all six pending assertions on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The homepage owner changed the pending Mac labels in both registered components and documented the archive states in 91de9f3246.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Harness record de7a6fad2218 passes all five unchanged render tests at 91de9f3246. The compiled Hub passes all nine frozen browser cases on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: The compiled Workerd homepage passes the nine unchanged browser cases at 91de9f3246. All pending and available home states also pass in the 70-case Hub matrix at 43f4b86d1d, sealed capture e064d0674bf5.
